name: 華國媛
objective:
本門授課之目的在於介紹奈米材料及其製程 (包括濕式及乾式奈米材料法)，並探討奈米材料的未來發展及應用。所包括的課程主題如下：1. 奈米材料與奈米化學簡介。2. 奈米材料與結構分析 3. 奈米材料製成 4. 奈米材料自我組成 5. 奈米材料模擬 6. 碳奈米微管 7. 中孔洞奈米晶體之合成 8. 半導體奈米粒之製備與應用 9. 奈米材料的遠景與未來發展
The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (wet method and dry method).  The future development and applications are also discussed.This course will cover the following topics:1.	Introduction of nanomaterials and nanochemistry2.	Nanomaterials:  structure and analysis3.	Nanomaterials:  processing4.	Nanomaterials:  self-assembly5.	Nanomaterials:  simulation6.	Carbon nanotubes7.	Synthesis and sintering of mesoporous nanocrystals8.	Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticlesProspective vision of nanomaterials
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Advanced Nanomaterials - Nanotechnology History and Evolution.
Week 2: Nanomaterials - Biological nano-molecules (special seminar: TBA)
Week 3: Dimensions of nanomaterials - 0D, 1D, 2D, and 3D
Week 4: Synthesis Approaches I - Bottom-up methods and Top-down methods
Week 5: Synthesis Approaches II- Modern Techniques - Atomic layer deposition, Chemical vapor deposition
Week 6: Molecular Dynamics- Bio-molecular dynamic with AI x ARx VR
Week 7: GROMACS program (molecular dynamics simulation - Basis)
Week 8: GROMACS program (molecular dynamics simulation - Advanced)
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Nanomaterials – metal organic framework (MOFs), and inorganic–organic hybrid nanocomposites.
Week 11: Carbon-based nanomaterials - fullerenes, graphene, carbon nanotubes, and carbon nanofibers.
Week 12: Core–Shell nanoparticles & Heterostructures - Gold nanoshells and hierarchical systems.
Week 13: Quantum mechanics 1
Week 14: Quantum mechanics 2
Week 15: Characterization of nanomaterials - Structural, functional group, and surface area analysis, Morphological analysis (SEM and TEM)
Week 16: Applications of nanomaterials in semiconductor industry
Week 17: 3D Chip- advanced chip design for AI application
Week 18: Final exam
